name: Nexus Mentality
oracle_text:
Choose one. If you control a commander as you cast this spell, you may choose both instead.
• Move all counters from target nonland permanent you control onto another target nonland permanent you control.
• Remove all counters from target nonland permanent you control. Draw a card for each counter removed this way.
blocked_sentences: • Remove all counters from target nonland permanent you control. Draw a card for each counter removed this way.

needs.what: remove_counters with an every-kind option (like move_counters' `all_kinds`) that removes the whole multiset of counters from the objects, plus an `as` binding recording how many were actually removed so a following `draw` amount can read "for each counter removed this way"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: remove_counters takes one `counter` kind and a fixed `amount` (op_remove_counters in ops_counters.py) and binds nothing; counters_on reads a single kind, not the sum of all kinds; counters_had reads only a dies-event snapshot. move_counters already has `all_kinds`, so the first mode and the choose_mode `up_to_if` commander clause are expressible -- only the second mode blocks the card
